# PropAI Pulse

PropAI Pulse is a real-time real estate intelligence platform for Mumbai. It uses AI to parse off-market inventory directly from broker WhatsApp broadcasts before they reach public portals.

## High-Level Purpose
- Real-time off-market inventory parsing.
- Direct connection to brokers via WhatsApp.
- Coverage of Mumbai micro-markets (Bandra, Worli, Powai, etc.).
- Intelligence mesh summarizing noisy broadcast data into clean property listings.

## Key Entry Points
- Home: https://propai.pulse/
- Listings: https://propai.pulse/listings
- Broker Signup: https://propai.pulse/broker/signup

## Data Structure
Property listings include:
- Title (Config: BHK + Typology)
- Locality (Mumbai micro-market)
- Price (INR)
- Raw Text (Original broadcast message)
- Features (Amenities, Floor, etc.)
- Broker Contact (WhatsApp link)
